_comment: Host init/teardown CI golden (Blackhole). BRING-UP: real_time values are real measurements captured locally on a Blackhole (p100a), centers of three consecutive runs that agreed to ~1% (init) / ~0.15% (teardown); used as realistic placeholders but NOT gated yet. The runtime_perf_host_init_teardown CI job runs compare_host_init_teardown_ci.py with --ignore-times so only structure (no errored benchmarks) is validated. Arm the gate by replacing these with a real benchmark_out JSON captured on bh_p150_perf CI silicon, then drop --ignore-times. Metric = host-side real_time (ns) of the min aggregate: BM_host_init = MeshDevice open (~100ms), BM_host_teardown = MeshDevice close (~113ms). bh_p150_perf is a single-chip SKU, so only single_chip runs here; mesh_2, mesh_4, ... light up on multi-device SKUs (see the wormhole golden).
